meta.name: Isola
meta.title: Isola H1 · Wireless over-ear headphones — demo
meta.tagline: Premium launch page with a scroll-driven 3D teardown.
meta.description: Launch page for fictional premium headphones: precise typography, a 3D model that comes apart as you scroll and an in-page reservation. three.js only downloads when needed, so the first view loads as text.
features: Procedural 3D model that turns and explodes with scroll
three.js loaded on demand: zero weight on first view
Finish picker that recolours both illustration and model
Reservation drawer with deep link and Back support

hero.title: Isola H1
hero.promise: Silence, tuned to the last detail.
hero.body: Adaptive noise cancelling, a 40 mm driver and 60 hours of battery in 254 grams of aluminium and memory foam.
hero.alt: Isola H1 over-ear headphones, three-quarter view

callouts.title: Memory foam cushions
callouts.body: Breathable vegan leather. Swap them in ten seconds.

callouts.title: 40 mm driver
callouts.body: Carbon fibre diaphragm, from 4 Hz to 40 kHz.

callouts.title: I1 ANC chip
callouts.body: Eight microphones, 48,000 noise adjustments a second.

callouts.title: 60 h battery
callouts.body: Ten minutes of charging give six hours of music.

callouts.title: Aluminium headband
callouts.body: Stepless fit and 254 g in total.

items.title: Silence that adapts
items.body: The I1 chip listens with eight microphones and tunes cancelling for the plane, the office or the street. No pressure in your ears.

items.title: Studio sound, uncoloured
items.body: A 40 mm driver with a carbon fibre diaphragm renders every detail with the flat response mixing engineers rely on.

items.title: A whole week of travel
items.body: Up to 60 hours without cancelling and 45 with it. Ten minutes on USB-C give you six more hours.

items.title: Built to last for years
items.body: Anodised aluminium headband, visible screws and replaceable cushions. Everything is repairable, nothing is thrown away.
